meta.notes: Campaign structure: which weeks exist, how long each runs and what budget the player starts with. This is the file to edit when adding, removing or rebalancing a week. Scenario content lives in scenarios.json; every scenario there carries a `week` field that must match a `number` below. Weeks unlock in order: week N+1 becomes playable once week N is completed.

weeks.title: Platform on-call
weeks.subtitle: You are the new Microsoft Fabric platform admin at Nordwind Logistics. The previous admin left a note: "Good luck. You will need it."

weeks.title: Peak season
weeks.subtitle: Peak season. Parcel volumes are six times normal, finance froze the capacity budget, and every shortcut you took in week 1 is now load bearing.

weeks.title: The merger
weeks.subtitle: Nordwind has absorbed a Belgian carrier. Two platforms, two engineering teams, one capacity, and a set of auditors who want everything documented.
